title: To direct the Secretary of Veterans Affairs to convey to the Florida Department of Veterans Affairs all right, title, and interest of the United States to the property known as "The Community Living Center" at the Lake Baldwin Veterans Affairs Outpatient Clinic, Orlando, Florida.
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was passed by the House on February 9, 2016. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

(Sec. 1) This bill directs the Department of Veterans Affairs to convey to the Florida Department of Veterans Affairs all right, title, and interest of the United States in the property known as "The Community Living Center" at the Lake Baldwin Veterans Affairs Outpatient Clinic, Orlando, Florida.

The deed of conveyance shall require all of the property to be used for the sole purpose of providing nursing home, domiciliary, or adult day health care to veterans.

summary.headline: A 2016 law requires the VA to transfer a federal building at the Lake Baldwin clinic in Orlando to Florida's veterans agency for veteran care.
summary.what_it_does: The law directs the Department of Veterans Affairs to give the State of Florida's Department of Veterans Affairs the federal government's ownership interest in "The Community Living Center" at the Lake Baldwin VA Outpatient Clinic in Orlando. The transfer deed must require that the property be used only to provide nursing home, domiciliary, or adult day health care to veterans. The summary does not describe other conditions or a deadline for completing the transfer.

who_it_affects.how: It would receive ownership of the Community Living Center property and must use it only for veteran nursing home, domiciliary, or adult day health care.
They may be able to receive nursing home, domiciliary, or adult day health care at the property under state operation.
It must carry out the transfer and prepare a deed with the required use restriction.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on February 29, 2016, and the summary does not state a separate effective date or deadline for the transfer.
